description: Convert an integer between binary, octal, decimal and hexadecimal. Arbitrary precision, so 64-bit and larger values convert exactly (no floating-point rounding).

from_base.description: Base the value is written in.

value.description: The number, written in the source base. A leading "-" is allowed; 0x / 0b / 0o prefixes are accepted.

name: number_base_convert
title: Convert between number bases
